tax.text: Bost voted for Republican tax-cut legislation and touts the tax reductions it delivered to his district.
tax.quote: Mike voted for Tax Reform legislation, which gives an average tax cut of over $2,200 to Southern Illinois families.

trade.text: Bost backs President Trump's protectionist trade deals as a way to shield U.S. industry and workers.
trade.quote: Mike supports President Trump's historic trade deals to protect our economy and American workers.

debt.text: Bost says he opposes privatizing Social Security and Medicare, raising the retirement age, or increasing the payroll tax.
debt.quote: Mike opposes efforts to privatize, raise the retirement age or increase the payroll tax.

immigration.text: Bost supports building a wall on the southern border and enforcing the Remain in Mexico policy.
immigration.quote: Mike supports building a wall along our southern border and supports enforcing President Trump's Remain in Mexico Policy.

health.text: Bost repeatedly voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act, arguing it raised costs and reduced choices.
health.quote: This law has led to higher costs, fewer choices, and less access to the quality care that people need.

wages.text: Fortier says strong unions built the middle class and raise wages when workers have a seat at the table.
wages.quote: Strong unions built America's middle class. When workers have a seat at the table, wages rise, workplaces become safer, and local economies grow stronger.

trade.text: Fortier opposes tariffs, arguing they disrupt markets and raise costs for farm inputs like fertilizer.
trade.quote: fighting against policies like tariffs and forever wars that disrupt the market and spike costs for necessary items like fertilizer.

schools.text: Fortier supports investing in public schools so every child gets a quality education.
schools.quote: I support investing in public schools because every child deserves a quality education that prepares them to think critically, succeed in life, and feel welcome in their school.

guns.text: While affirming Second Amendment rights, Fortier says she would back measures to keep firearms from dangerous individuals.
guns.quote: I will back common-sense measures that keep firearms out of the hands of dangerous individuals without infringing on the rights of law-abiding citizens.

abortion.text: Fortier supports codifying Roe v. Wade into federal law to protect access to legal abortion.
abortion.quote: I support codifying Roe v. Wade into federal law to restore medical privacy and ensure access to safe, legal reproductive services nationwide.

health.text: Fortier says health care should be affordable for everyone and the country should move toward a universal care option.
health.quote: Healthcare should be affordable, accessible, and dependable for everyone, and our country must move towards a universal care option.

energy.text: Fortier says climate change is real and calls for action, including opposing data centers in Southern Illinois.
energy.quote: the science is clear: climate change is real, and we must act
